description: Exact common main panel for 2001–2024; 43,797 rows, 2,021 cells.
A_unit: days earlier than within-cell mean onset
flux_units: I/K/R/early/late/annual: mm; centroid and quantile dates: day of year; advance and gaps: days; fractions: proportion
window: Reference SOS minus 16 to reference EOS plus 16; early ends at reference POS. Reference dates use main-quality phenology years.
covariance: 2° spatial block plus year minus intersection; t reference min(cluster counts)-1

pixel.definition: Zero-based index of the candidate location; links to the packaged candidate-location archive.

lon.definition: Longitude of the sampled 0.05-degree export cell center, EPSG:4326.

lat.definition: Latitude of the sampled 0.05-degree export cell center, EPSG:4326.

zone.definition: Supplied climate-zone code: 1 MTA; 2 MTH; 3 MTSA; 4 MTSH; 5 NSH; 6 PTSA; 7 WTSH.

igbp.definition: Modal IGBP cover: 3 deciduous needleleaf forest; 4 deciduous broadleaf forest; 5 mixed forest; 10 grassland in the common main panel.

area_km2.definition: Geodesic area of the sampled export cell; weights are normalized by their mean in estimation.

A.definition: Reference main-quality SOS minus annual SOS; positive means earlier fluorescence onset.

E_I.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Observed signed flux integrated from annual SOS to reference POS.

E_K.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Auxiliary all-year reference-curve integral over the same dates as I, including the focal year. The main manuscript uses K_loo.

E_R.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Auxiliary I minus K using the all-year curve. The main manuscript uses R_loo.

E_K_loo.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Leave-one-year-out reference-curve integral from annual SOS to reference POS; K in the main manuscript.

E_R_loo.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. I minus K_loo; R in the main manuscript. A water-depth anomaly integral, not an identified physiological effect.

E_early.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Signed flux integrated from reference SOS minus 16 days to reference POS.

E_late.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Signed flux integrated from reference POS to reference EOS plus 16 days.

E_annual.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Signed flux integrated over the complete actual calendar year (365 or 366 days).

E_centroid.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Positive-flux-weighted mean date over the fixed reference season, with fractional-day overlap midpoints.

E_q10.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Date when positive flux reaches 10% of its fixed-season cumulative sum, interpolated within the daily overlap segment.

E_q10_null.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. 10% date of the all-year reference curve circularly advanced by A, using the focal calendar length and fixed seasonal boundaries. Descriptive translation benchmark.

E_q25.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Date when positive flux reaches 25% of its fixed-season cumulative sum, interpolated within the daily overlap segment.

E_q25_null.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. 25% date of the all-year reference curve circularly advanced by A, using the focal calendar length and fixed seasonal boundaries. Descriptive translation benchmark.

E_q50.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Date when positive flux reaches 50% of its fixed-season cumulative sum, interpolated within the daily overlap segment.

E_q50_null.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. 50% date of the all-year reference curve circularly advanced by A, using the focal calendar length and fixed seasonal boundaries. Descriptive translation benchmark.

E_q75.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Date when positive flux reaches 75% of its fixed-season cumulative sum, interpolated within the daily overlap segment.

E_q75_null.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. 75% date of the all-year reference curve circularly advanced by A, using the focal calendar length and fixed seasonal boundaries. Descriptive translation benchmark.

E_q90.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Date when positive flux reaches 90% of its fixed-season cumulative sum, interpolated within the daily overlap segment.

E_q90_null.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. 90% date of the all-year reference curve circularly advanced by A, using the focal calendar length and fixed seasonal boundaries. Descriptive translation benchmark.

E_centroid_advance.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Cell mean centroid across available derived years minus its annual centroid; positive means earlier. This cell constant is absorbed by cell fixed effects.

E_q10_advance.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Cell mean observed 10% date across available derived years minus its annual date; positive means earlier.

E_q10_null_advance.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Unshifted reference 10% date minus shifted-reference 10% date. Fixed-season boundaries mean this need not equal A.

E_q10_gap.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. 10% translation-benchmark advance minus observed advance; directly modeled reference-minus-estimated contrast.

E_q25_advance.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Cell mean observed 25% date across available derived years minus its annual date; positive means earlier.

E_q25_null_advance.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. Unshifted reference 25% date minus shifted-reference 25% date. Fixed-season boundaries mean this need not equal A.

E_q25_gap.definition: Total modeled evaporation E. 25% translation-benchmark advance minus observed advance; directly modeled reference-minus-estimated contrast.

centroid_Et_minus_E_advance.definition: T centroid advance minus E centroid advance on the same row; modeled as a direct paired contrast.

centroid_Et_minus_En_advance.definition: T centroid advance minus N centroid advance on the same row; modeled as a direct paired contrast.

qdiff_Et_minus_E_q10.definition: T minus E advance of the 10% positive cumulative-flux date; direct paired timing contrast.

qdiff_Et_minus_En_q10.definition: T minus N advance of the 10% positive cumulative-flux date; direct paired timing contrast.

qdiff_Et_minus_E_q25.definition: T minus E advance of the 25% positive cumulative-flux date; direct paired timing contrast.

qdiff_Et_minus_En_q25.definition: T minus N advance of the 25% positive cumulative-flux date; direct paired timing contrast.

qdiff_Et_minus_E_q90.definition: T minus E advance of the 90% positive cumulative-flux date; direct paired timing contrast.

qdiff_Et_minus_En_q90.definition: T minus N advance of the 90% positive cumulative-flux date; direct paired timing contrast.

Et_fraction_annual.definition: Integrated T divided by integrated E over the annual interval, only where integrated E is positive. Not a mean of daily ratios; multiply a coefficient by 100 to express percentage points.

Et_fraction_early.definition: Integrated T divided by integrated E over the early interval, only where integrated E is positive. Not a mean of daily ratios; multiply a coefficient by 100 to express percentage points.

Et_fraction_late.definition: Integrated T divided by integrated E over the late interval, only where integrated E is positive. Not a mean of daily ratios; multiply a coefficient by 100 to express percentage points.

CSV_format.float_format: 17 significant digits; pandas float_precision=round_trip reproduces original floating-point values

timing_window: Fixed reference SOS minus 16 to reference EOS plus 16; positive daily rates only. Signed daily rates are retained for water-depth amounts.
source_code: methods/analysis/gleam_pnas_screen.py: derive_metrics; code/reproduce_main.py: exact common-panel regression. See the reviewer code repository.
